ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Qutai adds the screenshots and images you choose to save to your photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Qutai opens your photos only when you choose one to attach to a message to the assistant or to upload to a web page; it never looks through your library on its own.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Qutai uses the camera to scan QR codes, to take a photo or video for a web page’s upload field or a photo to attach to a message to the assistant, and for sites you allow to use it, such as video calls.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Qutai uses the microphone when you speak a message to the assistant, for sites you allow to use it, such as video calls, and to record sound when you take a video to upload to a web page.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Qutai turns what you say to the assistant into text. When your speech can’t be recognised on the device itself, Apple’s speech service receives the audio to do this; Qutai and your AI provider only get the text.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Qutai uses Face ID to unlock the app and incognito tabs.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Qutai adds events you confirm, such as tickets and reservations, to the calendar you choose, and reads your events only when you ask the assistant about your schedule and confirm.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Qutai lists your calendars so you can choose where new events go, and reads your events only when you ask the assistant about your schedule and confirm; it sends the events in the range you approved to your AI provider.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Qutai adds events you confirm, such as tickets and reservations, to your calendar.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Qutai adds reminders you confirm to the Reminders list you choose.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Qutai adds reminders you confirm to the Reminders list you choose.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Qutai shows your position to the sites you allow, such as maps, and to the assistant when you ask it to use your location. In setup it can fill in where you live when you tap to do so; Apple’s address service finds the place name for your position.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Qutai connects to an AI server on your local network only when you set one up as your custom AI endpoint.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Qutai looks up only the people you name to the assistant, on your phone, so you can call or message them. Their numbers and email addresses are not sent to the AI.
